steps.check: active tab text stays readable in the dark theme
steps.expr: (() => { const tab = document.querySelector('.dshcb-tab-active'); if (tab === null) return false; const style = getComputedStyle(tab); const rgb = (value) => (value.match(/[0-9.]+/g) ?? []).slice(0, 3).map(Number); const background = rgb(style.backgroundColor); const text = rgb(style.color); if (background.length < 3 || text.length < 3) return false; const luminance = ([r, g, b]) => { const channel = (value) => { const v = value / 255; return v <= 0.03928 ? v / 12.92 : Math.pow((v + 0.055) / 1.055, 2.4); }; return 0.2126 * channel(r) + 0.7152 * channel(g) + 0.0722 * channel(b); }; const high = Math.max(luminance(background), luminance(text)); const low = Math.min(luminance(background), luminance(text)); return (high + 0.05) / (low + 0.05) > 2.5; })()
